title: Pay the national self-exclusion register levy (wagering providers)
what: Licensed interactive wagering service providers that use the National Self-exclusion Register pay a cost recovery levy.

laws.title: National Self-exclusion Register (Cost Recovery Levy) Act 2019

sources.title: National Self-exclusion Register (Cost Recovery Levy) Act 2019
sources.quote: 7 Imposition of levy Levy is imposed on a person for a levy period if: (a) the person was a licensed interactive wagering service provider during the whole or a part of the levy period; and (b) the person made at least one request to the Register operator under subsection 61NC(1) of the Interactive Gambling Act 2001 during the levy period.

reach.condition: if it is a licensed interactive wagering service provider
